retrievalProfile.description: A high-energy 1970s soul aesthetic featuring a central performer under warm stage lights with bold, interlocking geometric display type and a multi-colored accent bar.

recipe.visualDefinition: A low-angle, medium-close-up shot of a male vocalist in a sequined shirt performing under dramatic red and amber stage lights, topped with heavy, stylized geometric lettering and a horizontal row of pastel-colored squares.
coreVisualRelationships: Typography anchored at the top center
Performer's head positioned directly below the text block
Microphone and cord creating a diagonal movement across the frame
Warm stage flares contrasting with deep shadow backgrounds
coreInvariants: Interlocking character strokes in the display type
A horizontal 'rainbow' bar of small squares separating text lines

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central medium-close-up of a performer, filling the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bold, white geometric title at the top center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the top title down to the performer's face, following the microphone cord's curve back up to the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep shadows in the upper corners and background provide high contrast for the subject and text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep shadows and warm amber/red stage lighting.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white for the primary typography.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pastel yellow, pink, and blue in the geometric separator bar.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in light flares against low-value, dark backgrounds.
paletteRestrictions: Stick to warm, earthy stage tones

letterConstructionRules: Extremely tight tracking with overlapping or touching characters
Rounded corners on all external and internal terminals
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'W' and 'M' use parallel vertical strokes
The 'R' has a short, curved leg that connects to the stem
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in two sizes, separated by a graphic bar.
graphicDevices: Horizontal row of multi-colored squares (pink, yellow, blue, white)
Thin horizontal rules bordering the color bar

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the geometric, rounded, and heavy aesthetic.
Matches the tubular, monolinear stroke and rounded terminals.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photograph of a male soul singer in a sequined shirt, holding a vintage microphone, under warm red and amber stage lights with heavy film grain and lens flares.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a bold, white, rounded geometric display font at the top center. Ensure letters touch. Place a horizontal bar of small pastel-colored squares between the two lines of text.

verificationChecks: Typography is centered at the top
Color bar contains at least 3 pastel colors

adjustableVariables: Color sequence in the geometric bar
postGenerationChecks: Does the text feel integrated into a 1970s era?
Is the lighting warm and dramatic?
Are the letters rounded and touching?
Is the color bar present and correctly positioned?
recipe.reuseFormula: Stage photography + Chiaroscuro lighting + Heavy Geometric Display Type + Pastel Color Bar = 70s Soul Aesthetic
